t: GLM 5.2 on Dual Strix Halo (256GB): Worth it?

q.x: Currently, llama.cpp clusters don't support tensor parallelism, have a look at Donato Capitella's detailed report: [link] He also provides rocm toolboxes for Strix Halo: [link]

recs.stt: AMD Strix Halo RDMA Cluster Setup Guide
recs.x:
I have two 128gb Strix Halos and have been extremely excited about Antirez's (Redis author) work on DS4, especially with 4bit quant using two machines: [link] 

Right now the speed isn't good for GLM 5.2, Deepseek V4 Flash speed is okay for me (actually reading the output) and quite usable. See kyuz0's great recent video here: [link]
